Sam (AE): Quick: Prospect wants an air-gapped POC. Requirements: signed bundles (customer-held key), SBOM, manual-only upgrades, predictable cadence, and an ops one-pager. Procurement hates monthly invoices. Kickoff next Wed.
Diego (SE): Understood. Need model target (7B/13B) and quantization. Typical sizes: 7B q4 ~600MB, 13B q4 ~1.1GB. Bundle flavors: model-only, runtime+model, full bundle.
Asha (Infra): Customer-held signing supported. Two flows: (1) customer signs artifacts locally and supplies public key fingerprint; (2) we sign if they permit. If keys remain offline we require OOB fingerprint exchange (on-site or video handshake). Recommend HSM for key custody.
Nia (Solutions): Commercial options to propose: A) Annual subscription (invoiced annually) with X minibundles/year; B) Perpetual license + annual maintenance (invoiced annually) + per-bundle eng fees. Add-on: remote assist installs.
Sam (AE): Can we commit to manual-only upgrades? They want no surprise auto-push.
Asha (Infra): Yes. Air-gapped installs are always manual. CLI supports verify + apply. Sample: `./rw-offline verify --bundle /mnt/usb/minibundle.tar.gz && ./rw-offline apply --bundle /mnt/usb/minibundle.tar.gz` Rollback: snapshot-based, operator-triggered.
Diego (SE): We can produce minibundles (delta) to reduce transfer. Caveat: q2 quantization reduces size but needs perf/quality eval signoff.
ops-bot: Ticket SALES-7200 created: "Prospect airgap POC - signing & cadence" assigned to Diego, Nia.
Nia (Solutions): Actions: I'll draft two short proposals + SOW with calendar anchors (e.g., "first Tue" monthly patch window); Diego to produce a minibundle size table and 1p runbook; Asha to prepare key-onboarding checklist and HSM recommendation for Legal (ETA 48h). Sam to coordinate prospect kickoff. :white_check_mark:
